minor: Every mirror has two sides, and both of them work, so one mirror can turn two different beams at once. Whenever you place a mirror, follow the light bouncing off its back too. And look for beams that are heading straight for the wrong letter: they have to turn before they get there.
major: Put a top-left to bottom-right mirror on the square just above the A at the bottom. That connects the two A's. Now follow the light from the B on the right: it bounces off the back of that same mirror and heads up. Where does it need to turn so that it reaches the B in the middle?
